basic_info.chief_complaint: Receive a referral for root canal treatment.

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: Receive a referral for root canal treatment.

oral_examination.oral_examination: 47 CBCT shows that deep caries penetrates the pulp, and no obvious shadow is seen in the root tip.

treatment_plan.definitive: 47 Root canal treatment and crown restoration.

source_handle: 47 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Under periodontal ligament anesthesia with 4% articaine, the pulp was opened, the pulp hole was enlarged, arsenic-free inactivating agent was used, and polycarboxylate was temporarily sealed.
